android.desc:
Raise and train an army of legendary dragons, build a powerful kingdom, and found your own civilization of Atlantis! Compete online with players around the world to awaken the buried memories of Atlantis!
►►►Feed, train, and command fully animated 3D dragons ◄◄◄
►►►Assert your dominance in the retro fantasy land of Atlantis◄◄◄
►►►No VIP system or stamina limitations, enjoy a pure, hard-core strategy game◄◄◄

Join "Dragons of Atlantis: Heirs of the Dragon" now and restore the long-lost glory with players from around the world! The dragons are about to become extinct, and it's up to you to rebuild the once prosperous city, revive ancient wisdom, and save the dragons of Atlantis! Join now to:


CONTROL YOUR OWN 3D DRAGON ARMY
Grow your dragon in fully interactive HD environments and unlock unique abilities through ancient skills.


BUILD AN ALLIANCE WITH GLOBAL PLAYERS
Develop real-time strategies with allies from around the world to eliminate your opponents!


WRITE YOUR OWN HISTORY IN MULTIPLE GAME MODES
Rely on your knowledge and power to obtain generous rewards though PVE and PVP gameplay！
